meaning: Repeated deterioration greater than 10 percent in a critical path requires investigation and an explicit reviewed tradeoff; not an automatic safety waiver.
comparison_protocol: Same machine, filesystem, dataset, SQLite/tool versions, concurrency and observers; at least three interleaved reference/candidate release runs. Report all samples and median/p95. Do not select the fastest run.
safety: No reduction in validation, boundedness, source preservation, ownership or recovery to meet timing targets.
current_capture: Reference-only discovery measurements. Synthetic, scan and high-cardinality runners overlapped; timings are contended and cannot serve as isolated release-comparison thresholds.
not_yet_measured: application bytes read (block counters are not bytes)
temporary disk and descriptor high-water marks

measured_runtime_scope.writer_lock_hold: instrumented Store lock acquire-to-close intervals in a 100-file fixture
measured_runtime_scope.cancellation: 10 queued jobs and 5 running subprocess groups; not complete active-encoder cancellation
measured_runtime_scope.resources: harness peak RSS, one FD snapshot, retained fixture size and OS block counters; not disk/FD high-water or logical bytes read
